description: Search US court cases, attorneys and judges by name, case name or case number. Cases come from the latest 5 filing years unless year is set. Returns IDs for get_case, get_attorney and get_judge, and a report_url for each hit.

query.description: Name, case name or case number

state.description: Full US state name, e.g. "New York"

year.description: Filing year to search cases in. Without it, cases come from the latest 5 years only; set it to find an older case

name: search
title: Search court records
